subject: Minor fix for build failures (#741)
reason: The change only adds a local declaration `auto &schema_manager = SchemaManager::Instance();` so the pre-existing `schema_manager.GetIndexSchema(...)` call in QueryCommand::Execute compiles — a pure build fix for a compile error introduced by the parent commit. It binds the same singleton that was being used, so there is no behaviour change to FT.SEARCH/FT.AGGREGATE or anything else: no reply, data, replication or persistence path differs between builds, and nothing can be exercised that would distinguish them.
